title: Installation Coordination Note: Ridgeline Installation Services Contract Status and Special Order Damage Allowance Percentage
content:
For a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, the percentage at which a damage allowance is figured follows the status of the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract at the delivery address.

**Clause.** The allowance percentage depends on the status of the customer's Ridgeline installation contract at the delivery address: a contract there that is scheduled or in progress, so a Ridgeline installer will handle the item on site, gives 10 percent; a contract there that is cancelled, so the customer installs and touches up the item without a Ridgeline crew, gives 16 percent; otherwise the percentage is the program's damage allowance percentage.

The allowance percentage is the percentage of the order total billed at which the damage allowance is figured.

## Records read

The customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract records: the job address, which must be the delivery address of the special order, and the contract status.

## Percentage by contract status at the delivery address

| Contract at the delivery address | Allowance percentage |
|---|---|
| scheduled | 10 |
| in progress | 10 |
| cancelled | 16 |
| measure booked, measured, contracted, completed or closed | the program's damage allowance percentage |
| no contract at that address | the program's damage allowance percentage |

For the deposit programs the program's damage allowance percentage is 15 for Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors, 15 for Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry and 0 for Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Semi-Custom Cabinetry order, order total billed 1800.00)

| Contract at the delivery address | Percentage | Allowance figure |
|---|---|---|
| scheduled | 10 | 180.00 |
| cancelled | 16 | 288.00 |
| none | 15 | 270.00 |
